name: Hotel Hermitage
insider_take: This Belle Époque jewel sits mere steps from Monaco's legendary Casino de Monte-Carlo, where European royalty has played since 1863.
whats_special: Hotel Hermitage's stunning Winter Garden features an original Gustave Eiffel glass dome from 1900, creating a luminous dining space beneath intricate ironwork. The hotel's direct underground passage connects guests to the Casino and Café de Paris without stepping outside.
pro_tip: Book a Diamond Suite facing the Mediterranean for unobstructed views of the Monaco Grand Prix circuit – you'll watch F1 cars navigate the famous Fairmont Hairpin turn from your private terrace.
dont_miss: The Thermes Marins Monte-Carlo spa, accessible via private elevator, offers thalassotherapy treatments using Mediterranean seawater. Evening aperitifs at Bar Beaumarchais provide front-row seats to Monaco's yacht-filled harbor and the Prince's Palace perched on Le Rocher.
pros: Prime Monte Carlo location with stunning Mediterranean views
Belle Époque architecture and elegant classic décor
Direct access to Casino Square and luxury shopping
Exceptional spa and wellness facilities with thermal suite
cons: Premium pricing reflects exclusive Monte Carlo location
Formal atmosphere may not suit casual travelers
